A music streaming service founded in Stockholm, Sweden, in 2006 by Daniel Ek and Martin Lorentzon. It launched in 2008.

It arrived when the music business was shrinking. File sharing sites like Napster had taught a generation to get songs for free, and record sales were falling. Spotify offered something easier than piracy: almost any song, at once, free with adverts or paid without them. It signed deals with the big labels, which took shares in the firm.

Streaming then replaced buying records and downloads as the main way people listen to music, and by the 2020s Spotify had hundreds of millions of users. Rivals such as Apple followed. Artists complain that each stream pays very little, and the service has moved into podcasts and audiobooks. Like Skype, it made the Nordic countries a source of global tech.
sum: A music streaming service founded in Stockholm, Sweden, in 2006 by Daniel Ek and Martin Lorentzon. It launched in 2008.
